topology_reasoning.device_identification: The black material is a compact slab/MMI-style fanout or star-coupler primitive: one broad rectangular multimode body, four single-mode access guides entering from the top through linear adiabatic tapers, and one lower centered access guide through a reverse taper.
topology_reasoning.operation: The large slab supports multimode propagation and interference/mixing. The four upper ports sample or inject the multimode field at set lateral positions, while the centered lower port couples through a wider taper into the slab. The image defines geometry only; no external paper or neighboring experiment outputs were used.
function_defining_knobs: body_length_um: lateral multimode/slab extent and port spacing envelope
top_port_pitch_um/top_port_offsets_um: relative phase/sample positions of the four upper ports
top_taper_length_um: adiabatic transition length into the slab
top_taper_wide_um and bottom_taper_wide_um: aperture widths at the slab interfaces
bottom_taper_length_um: lower access transition length, exposed as delta_length for evaluator knob-response verification
topology_reasoning.primitive_plan: Assemble layer-(1,0) rectangles for the slab and straight access sections, and gf.components.taper references for the top and bottom linear tapers. No raw polygons or higher-level device stencils are used.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only reconstruction from calibrated raster measurements. The diff review showed mostly blue edge underfill from antialiasing/edge softness and negligible red false-positive area, so this iteration met the stop criterion and was kept as best.
